market_outlook.short_term: Equities face headwinds from 5.2% 10Y yield, falling consumer sentiment, and oil volatility. Tech/AI names provide support but rotation into value/energy likely. Expect 3-5% equity volatility. Dollar remains strong but may peak. Oil binary on Iran dominates energy complex.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (Meta $2T, multi-vendor chip race) supports 6-12mo equity upside. However, 5%+ rate regime compresses multiples for non-earning growth. Consumer squeeze may persist 2-3 quarters. US-China truce buys time but Nov 2026 expiration is key risk. Defense and energy structurally supported by geopolitics.
